IBM raises annual software revenue outlook as deal delays ease

In an interview with Reuters, Kavanaugh said ​IBM now expects annual software revenue growth of about ​7% to 8%, up from 6% to 8% ⁠previously. IBM's shares rose about 4% in extended trading.

Third-quarter revenue rose 4.7% to $17.10 billion, above ​analysts' average estimate of $16.82 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG

Software revenue rose 8.3% to $7.80 billion in the third quarter, topping estimates of $7.62 billion

Kavanaugh ​said about 25% of the transaction processing ​revenue came ⁠from deals deferred from the second quarter and "the remaining 75% is net new business"
